sql_log.purpose: Compare frozen object/hash/edge claims to post-cut catalog state.
sql_log.sql:
with hist as (
 select x->>'caller' caller,split_part(x->>'caller','.',1) nspname,split_part(x->>'caller','.',2) proname,
 (x->>'caller_oid')::oid historical_oid,x->>'definition_md5' historical_md5,x->'callees' callees
 from public.lf_eventos e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x where e.id=20161
), resolved as (
 select h.*,p.oid current_oid,md5(p.prosrc) current_md5,p.prosrc current_body
 from hist h left join pg_namespace n on n.nspname=h.nspname
 left join pg_proc p on p.pronamespace=n.oid and p.proname=h.proname
), per_caller as (
 select caller,historical_oid,historical_md5,callees,count(current_oid) current_matches,
 bool_or(current_oid=historical_oid) same_oid,bool_or(current_md5=historical_md5) hash_match,
 max(current_body) filter(where current_oid=historical_oid) selected_body
 from resolved group by caller,historical_oid,historical_md5,callees
), edges as (
 select p.caller,c.value #>> '{}' callee,
 case when p.selected_body is null then null else position(lower(c.value #>> '{}') in lower(p.selected_body))>0 end text_present
 from per_caller p cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(p.callees)c
)
select
 (select count(*) from per_caller) historical_callers,
 (select count(*) from per_caller where current_matches=0) absent,
 (select count(*) from per_caller where current_matches>1) overloaded,
 (select count(*) from per_caller where same_oid) same_oid,
 (select count(*) from per_caller where hash_match) hash_match,
 (select count(*) from per_caller where current_matches>0 and not hash_match) hash_mismatch,
 (select count(*) from edges) declared_edges,
 (select count(*) from edges where text_present) edge_text_present,
 (select count(*) from edges where text_present is false) edge_text_absent,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('caller',caller,'callee',callee) order by caller,callee) from edges where text_present is false) absent_edges

sql_log.purpose: Measure current related variant families and body diversity.
sql_log.sql:
with f as (
 select n.nspname,p.proname,p.oid,
 regexp_replace(p.proname,'(_cached_v[0-9]+|_ctx|_v[0-9]+)$','','g') family_key,
 md5(p.prosrc) body_md5
 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
 where n.nspname in ('programacion','public')
 and (p.proname ilike '%input_governance%' or p.proname ilike '%input_readiness%')
), fam as (
 select family_key,count(*) members,count(distinct body_md5) bodies,
 jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',nspname,'name',proname,'oid',oid,'body_md5',body_md5) order by nspname,proname,oid) variants
 from f group by family_key
)
select (select count(*) from f) related_objects,
       (select count(*) from fam) families,
       (select count(*) from fam where members>1) multi_member_families,
       (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('family',family_key,'members',members,'bodies',bodies,'variants',variants) order by members desc,family_key) from fam where members>1) multi_members

sql_log.purpose: Test whether pg_depend can supply semantic function-call edges for the frozen functions.
sql_log.sql:
with hist as (
 select (x->>'caller_oid')::oid oid
 from public.lf_eventos e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x where e.id=20161
)
select d.refclassid::regclass::text as referenced_catalog,d.deptype,count(*) dependencies,
       count(*) filter(where d.refclassid='pg_proc'::regclass) as function_dependencies
from pg_depend d join hist h on d.objid=h.oid and d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass
group by d.refclassid,d.deptype
order by dependencies desc,referenced_catalog
